typinganimation.title: Typing Animation
typinganimation.description: Smooth animations for typing in chat, commands and other text fields: new characters glide in, deleted ones drift away, and the text and cursor move fluidly.
typinganimation.config.preview.hint: Type here to try it out...
typinganimation.config.demo.text: Jumpy zombies quickly vex a brave wolf and ghast!
typinganimation.config.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When off, every text field behaves exactly like vanilla.
typinganimation.config.easing.tooltip: Shape of the animation curve. Auto picks the curve that suits each style best.
typinganimation.config.durationMs.toolti: How long a new character takes to settle in.
typinganimation.config.intensity.tooltip: How far characters travel, how much they spin and how hard they bounce.
typinganimation.config.staggerMs.tooltip: Delay between characters when many appear at once, e.g. when pasting or recalling chat history.
typinganimation.config.glideMs.tooltip: How quickly shifted text catches up with its new position. Cursor glide has its own setting. 0 = instant.
typinganimation.config.smoothReflow.tool: Characters glide to their new place when the text shifts or scrolls, instead of jumping.
typinganimation.config.smoothCursor.tool: The text cursor glides to its new position instead of jumping.
typinganimation.config.animateChat.toolt: Animate typing in the chat and the command line.
typinganimation.config.animateOtherField: Animate every other single-line text field: search boxes, the anvil, world and server names and more.
Animate book pages (including Scholar), supported command editors, descriptions and report comments. Navigation and initial text stay still.
typinganimation.config.pauseOptionsButto: Show the Typing Animation button in Minecraft Options opened from the pause menu. Turn this off to hide it in game; the main-menu Options button is unaffected. No Mod Menu required.
typinganimation.config.optionsButton.too: Show a Typing Animation button in Minecraft Options. When hidden, open these settings from the mods list. On Fabric/Quilt, hiding this global button requires Mod Menu.
How long a deleted character stays visible as it animates out.
typinganimation.config.removeIntensity.t: Distance, rotation and scale of deleted characters. Independent of the appearance effect.
typinganimation.config.maxStaggerMs.tool: Maximum delay from the first to the last character when pasting or recalling text. 0 = all characters appear together.
typinganimation.config.cursorGlideMs.too: How smoothly the cursor catches up when you type, click or move with the arrow keys. Larger values glide more slowly. 0 = instant.
typinganimation.config.cursorStyle.toolt: Keep the vanilla cursor, or choose a vertical bar, underline or translucent block.
typinganimation.config.cursorColor.toolt: Use the field's original color, or give the animated cursor a personal accent color.
typinganimation.config.cursorWidth.toolt: Thickness of the bar or underline in GUI pixels. The block follows the character width.
typinganimation.config.animateSigns.tool: Animate letters and the cursor while editing normal signs and hanging signs, on either side.
typinganimation.config.onlyWhenFocused.t: Animate a field only while it has keyboard focus. Turn off to also animate updates to unfocused fields.
typinganimation.config.visualPreset.tool: Browse complete visual setups, then press Apply. Custom means individual settings were changed. Browsing does not change your current look.
typinganimation.config.applyPreset.toolt: Apply the selected visual preset. Replaces motion and cursor settings; keeps sounds, field toggles and the master switch.
typinganimation.config.typingSounds.tool: Play keyboard sounds when you type in supported text fields. Off by default. Sounds are local and are not sent to other players.
typinganimation.config.soundPreset.toolt: Choose the keyboard sound: typewriter, mechanical switches, soft keys or laptop.
typinganimation.config.soundVolume.toolt: Loudness of typing sounds and the sound test. 0% is silent.
typinganimation.config.soundPitch.toolti: Lower values sound deeper; higher values sound brighter. Applies to typing sounds and the sound test.
typinganimation.config.soundVariation.to: Vary the pitch slightly between keystrokes for a natural feel. Sample selection remains varied when this is off.
typinganimation.config.soundOnDelete.too: Play a deletion sound when Backspace or Delete removes text.
typinganimation.config.soundOnEnter.tool: Play an Enter sound when confirming chat or changing lines in a text editor.
typinganimation.config.soundTest.tooltip: Listen to a short typing, space, Backspace and Enter sample. Works even with Typing Sounds off; uses your volume and pitch. Demo previews visuals.
typinganimation.config.adaptiveTyping.to: Shorten animations and soften sounds during rapid typing. Slow typing keeps the full effect.
typinganimation.config.cursorCustomColor: Use the HEX colour below instead of the colour palette.
typinganimation.config.cursorHexColor.to: Enter #RRGGBB, for example #C4B5FD. Red text means the value is incomplete; the last valid colour is kept. Enable Custom cursor colour to use it.
typinganimation.config.cursorBlinkMs.too: Length of a complete visible/hidden blink cycle.
typinganimation.config.cursorSoftBlink.t: Fade the cursor in and out instead of switching it abruptly.
typinganimation.config.cursorKeepVisible: Keep the caret visible while actively editing, then resume blinking.
typinganimation.config.mode.question: How much would you like to adjust?
typinganimation.config.optionsButton.req: Hiding the global Options button requires Mod Menu on Fabric/Quilt, or the built-in mods list on Forge/NeoForge. You can hide only the in-game button without either.
typinganimation.config.library.name: Name for saving, duplicating or renaming
typinganimation.config.library.path: Paste a file path or drop a file here
typinganimation.config.library.pathHint: Import: full path to a preset JSON file. Export: full destination path; leave empty to export beside your saved presets. Existing files are never overwritten.
typinganimation.config.library.soundPath: Import a ZIP with pack.json and short Ogg Vorbis samples. The archive stays local. Maximum 32 MB; key samples are required.
typinganimation.config.library.soundHint: Choose a pack, listen, then press Use.
typinganimation.config.library.invalidPa: Check the file path and try again.
typinganimation.config.library.pathRequi: Paste the full file path first.
typinganimation.config.library.used: Sound pack selected. Enable typing sounds to hear it while editing.
typinganimation.config.library.ready: Sound library updated. Choose Use to select the pack.
typinganimation.config.library.reloadFai: Sound reload failed. Reopen the game to try again.
typinganimation.config.library.confirmDe: Press Delete again to remove the selected item.
typinganimation.config.library.result.in: Use a name of up to 40 characters without path symbols.
typinganimation.config.library.result.al: That name or destination file already exists. Choose another.
typinganimation.config.library.result.in: This is not a valid Typing Animation preset.
typinganimation.config.library.result.un: This preset uses an unsupported format version.
typinganimation.config.library.result.to: The preset file is too large.
typinganimation.config.library.result.io: Could not read or write the file. Check the path and permissions.
